metrics.label: First-time issue reporters
metrics.description: People filing their first observed issue in the selected repositories. Counts are distinct per day.

metrics.label: Issues opened
metrics.description: New issues across the selected repositories, including issues filed by automation.

metrics.label: People filing issues
metrics.description: Distinct people filing an issue each day. Bots and unavailable identities are excluded.

metrics.label: Issues per reporter
metrics.description: Issue volume divided by daily distinct reporters, relative to the same ratio at baseline.

metrics.label: PRs opened, net of supersession
metrics.description: PRs opened by people, excluding known superseded or landed-elsewhere PRs. Supersession is classified for duckdb/duckdb only.

metrics.label: People with a merged PR
metrics.description: Distinct people with at least one merged PR each day. This reduces the effect of PR bundles.

metrics.label: Issues closed
metrics.description: Issues by latest recorded closure timestamp, including issues filed before release. Closures are not confirmed fixes.
